description: Create a DHIS2 option set named 'Referral Reason' with the code 'REFERRAL_REASON'. Add these six options (in order): 'Emergency obstetric care' (Code: EMOC), 'Surgical intervention' (Code: SURG), 'Diagnostic imaging' (Code: DIAG), 'Specialist consultation' (Code: SPEC), 'Blood transfusion' (Code: BTRANS), and 'Other' (Code: OTHER). Then, create a Data Element named 'Facility Referral Reason' (Short name: 'Fac Referral Reason', Code: 'FAC_REF_REASON') with Domain type 'Aggregate', Value type 'Text', and link it to the 'Referral Reason' option set you just created.
